caption_L1: Life expectancy (from birth) in Germany , from 1875 to 2020 is a line graph. The y-axis plots Life expectancy in years on a linear scale from 0 to 80. The x-axis plots Year with a linear scale from 1880 to 2000.
caption_L2L3: Overall life expectancy has rises from just under 40 in 1875 to over 80 in 2020. There were dips in the increasing life expectancy in both 1920 and in the 1940s.
